newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE-RUSSIA C.BANK SELLS 176 BLN RBLS BILLS,BONDS.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-RUSSIA C.BANK SELLS 176 BLN RBLS BILLS,BONDS.

text.p: The central bank sold 176.00 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Tuesday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:

The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 21080 issue closed on Tuesday at 84.81 percent, the 21082 issue at 84.47 percent, the 21083 issue at 84.27 percent, the 24016 issue at 96.35 percent and the 24017 issue at 96.20 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
